title: Aye Muslim e Gareeb
body:
Lyrics
Aye Muslim-E-Ghareeb..(6)
<<MINI>>
Kar Rahi Thi Lashae Muslim Pe Ye Zahra (S.a.) Buka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Ali (A.s.), Ya Ali (A.s.) Koofe Me Fir Aayi Hai Rone Sayyeda (S.a.)
<<MINI>>
Kar Rahi Thi Lashae Muslim (A.s.) Pe Ye Zahra (S.a.) Buka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aap Par Jab Ibne Muljim Ne Kiya Sajde Me Waar
Hath Pehlu Par Rakhe Yaha Aai Thi Me Pehli Baar
Aaj Fir Us Haal Me Zahra (S.a.) Ko Hai Aana Pada
<<MINI>>
Kar Rahi Thi Lashae Muslim (A.s.) Pe Ye Zahra (S.a.) Buka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Koofe Walo Ne Ise Milkar Hai Maara Ya Ali (A.s.)
Lashae Muslim Hai Aise Para Para Ya Ali (A.s.)
Jism Hai Sara Mere Bache Ka Zakhmo Se Bhara
<<MINI>>
Kar Rahi Thi Lashae Muslim (A.s.) Pe Ye Zahra (S.a.) Buka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis Tarah Maine Sambhala Kis Tarah Thamba Ise
Kya Batau Mai Khadi Thi Hath Phailaye Hue
Darul Ammara Se Jab Tha Lashae Muslim (A.s.) Gira
<<MINI>>
Kar Rahi Thi Lashae Muslim (A.s.) Pe Ye Zahra (S.a.) Buka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch Hi Din Me Phir Yaha Aungi Mai Roti Hui
Iske Bacho Par Chalegi Jab Ke Haris (L.a.) Ki Churi
Mai Sambhalungi Unhe Aakar Ruqaiyya Ki Jagah
<<MINI>>
Kar Rahi Thi Lashae Muslim (A.s.) Pe Ye Zahra (S.a.) Buka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Dushmani Ale Nabi (A.s.) Se Is Tarha Dikhlaenge
Yu Mohammad (A.s.) Aur Ibrahim (A.s.) Mare Jaenge
Naam Ka Bhi Paas Rakhenge Na Kuch Ehle Jafa
<<MINI>>
Kar Rahi Thi Lashae Muslim (A.s.) Pe Ye Zahra (S.a.) Buka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kar Rahe Hai Zulm Ki Tafseer Ye Chehro Ke Neel
Kat Rahi Hai Aaj Jo Dar Dar Ye Aulade Aqeel (A.s.)
Hai Yaqeenan Ye Mere Bacho Se Ulfat Ki Saza
<<MINI>>
Kar Rahi Thi Lashae Muslim (A.s.) Pe Ye Zahra (S.a.) Buka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Bain The Akbar Zabane Sayyada Par Bas Yahi
Sath Zainab (S.a.) Ke Yaha Fir Mujhko Aana Hai Abhi
Shaam Tak Lejaega Koofe Se Ghum Ka Silsila
<<MINI>>
Kar Rahi Thi Lashae Muslim (A.s.) Pe Ye Zahra (S.a.) Buka..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Muslim-E-Ghareeb..(4)
